description: Cross-venue prediction-market mispricing scan (Polymarket, Kalshi, Hyperliquid outcomes), read-only and alert only. Lookalike titles only propose candidates; a pair is ranked only when resolution source, outcome semantics, denomination, void rule and close window match. Others are listed under notComparable with reasons. Buys YES on one venue plus NO on the other at executable asks for sizeUsd shares. Any unknown leg fee leaves net unknown, labelled cost unknown, ranked below known nets. A failed venue marks the scan partial. Kalshi is US-regulated; Oracle never routes orders.

category.description: Client-side keyword filter over title and category fields.

maxPairs.description: Candidate pairs checked, highest title similarity first. Default 50.

maxStaleSeconds.description: Book age above this marks a leg stale. Default 60.

minEdgeBps.description: Minimum net edge in bps (gross for cost-unknown pairs). Default 0.

query.description: Client-side keyword filter over market titles.

sizeUsd.description: Shares per leg, equal to the USD payout at resolution. Default 100.

name: prediction_xvenue
